# Brevier

> Brevier is an Android browser for reading, without JavaScript. It fetches a page, turns it into Markdown on the reader's phone, and renders it as native text in the reader's typography. Public Cloud Mail and Yandex Disk PDF shares, feeds, repository documentation, notes, and reading progress are supported. The core is Rust. MIT or Apache-2.0.

## This site

- [Brevier — a browser for reading](https://brevier.bizibah.com/index.md): the whole page as Markdown

- [Source and README](https://github.com/gurov/brevier): what it does and how to install the Android app

- [Manifesto](https://github.com/gurov/brevier/blob/main/MANIFESTO.md): what Brevier promises
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/gurov/brevier/blob/main/ROADMAP.md): where it is going next

The Linux CLI in the source repository is for internal parser validation and is not a public product.
